_comment: Reasoned exceptions for kit-lint. EVERY entry carries a reason. An allowlist without reasons rots into a dumping ground for 'we'll fix it later' — and then the lint means nothing, exactly like a gate everyone clicks through. Adding an entry is a decision; deleting one is always allowed.
